title: Register and freeze embedding+reranker manifest; publish performance snapshot for production rollout
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Goal: Register a new encoder+reranker bundle into the catalog, freeze a versioned manifest that captures artifact provenance and runtime performance snapshots (latency, throughput, token-efficiency), and enable a controlled production rollout (canary -> gradual ramp). This ticket covers the work to create a deterministic manifest, run workload-specific microbenchmarks, publish the snapshot to the profiles store, and add rollback safety hooks. Avoid using the legacy onboarding flow; instead use the new manifest schema v2 and the compatibility validator. Deliverables: 1) manifest-v2 JSON for the bundle with fingerprints, compatible-variant matrix, quantization recommendations; 2) performance snapshot artifacts (CSV + JSON summary) saved to S3 and referenced in the manifest; 3) automated compatibility check in CI; 4) canary job in runtime orchestrator and a rollback playbook. This is targeted at embeddings+ranks used by search and semantic rerank pipelines.
acceptance_criteria: Manifest-v2 is generated with model hashes, training artifact provenance, and variant compatibility list
Performance snapshot contains p50/p95/p99 latency and throughput for 128 and 512 token contexts on dedicated GPU types (A100-40g and T4) and is attached to the manifest
CI gate runs compatibility validator and fails on missing required fields or cross-variant incompatibilities
Canary rollout config exists in runtime orchestrator that routes 2% of traffic; metrics dashboard shows canary vs baseline plots
Rollback automated to revert routing to baseline variant and mark manifest as deprecated in catalog
Documentation and runbook link present in manifest and PR description
